mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific trigger conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is declining (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0%, it indicates a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and suppresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weakening consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities; this interaction predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1150 and RSAFS < 490000 or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a rising unemployment rate signals labor market cooling and reduced corporate hiring, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative in late-cycle expansions (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing output decline below 105.0 indicates a contraction in industrial activity, which typically precedes a recession and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 105.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1150.0 thousand units signal a weakening housing market, which reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1150.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing output decline below 100.0 indicates a severe economic contraction, which typically causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Payrolls exceeding 148,000 thousand persons indicates a strong labor market, which typically leads to inflationary pressures and monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS > 148000 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
